headline: DeepSeek's flash model is day two of holding the all-time share record, at 17.0% of tokens
summary: DeepSeek's deepseek-v4.1-flash is still refusing to give up the all-time crown, now at 17.0% of tokens on its second straight day. DeepSeek as a provider holds 30.8% overall, and the top two providers together account for 42.3%.
highlights: MiniMax's m3.1-flash held #2 at 10.9%, though its provider lost 6.7% of share over the day.
The top three providers hold 52.1% between them, and the top four reach 61.1%.
Mistral Large 4.0 debuted at #46 with 0.3% of tokens, while GPT-5.6 Terra came in at #51 with 0.2%.
GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Sol both fell off the board, last seen at #47 and #49.
StepFun's step-5-preview jumped 10 places to #13, and Grok 4.7 climbed 11 places to #31.
Claude Haiku 5.5 rose 6 places to #12 and set a fresh all-time record at 2.5% of tokens.
